sections.label: Switches
sections.note: The Panel's switches: every on/off the tool has apart from single creatures. All off stops every job and puts back every write; all on restores the switches as they were.

sections.label: Limits and release clock
sections.note: How many groups each layer holds at once (the map-size formula or one fixed cap, R7), the animal ceilings, and the adaptive release clock that paces new groups (R31).

sections.label: Cavern gate and natives
sections.note: Caverns are gated on their own count, five groups per cavern by default (R44); natives can be adopted and counted; animal people are capped in the caverns (R35).

sections.label: Leaders, panic and cohesion
sections.note: A group follows its largest adult male; when he dies the group panics and scatters (R32). Cohesion keeps followers within a distance of the leader.

sections.label: Roster builder and apexes
sections.note: The guild roster builder's ladder and pyramid, the R13/R26 pick and frequency multipliers, and the apex scheduler that keeps an apex group on the map a share of each season.

sections.label: Ecology and hunters
sections.note: Predators and prey related in DF's table; per-species skill profiles (solitary, pack), raptor stoops, bears that fish, swimmer scavengers.

sections.label: Water
sections.note: The tool draws river, lake and sea groups (DF sends none in play), weighted by what is already swimming (R62); prey pulls predators in (R14) and a guard rescues stranded swimmers.

sections.label: Aquarium
sections.note: See the life of your seas, lakes and rivers: a lens shows the creatures below the level you look at through the water, depth-faded, schools bracketed and leaders ringed, with a legend; ocean waves and foam are drawn; a translucent-water graphics mod is built from your own vanilla sheets.

sections.label: Scavenging and curious beasts
sections.note: Bone-eaters and carnivorous swimmers find remains after a natural delay, walk to them and eat over visits (R16-R18, R42). Curious thieves steal, then stay (R30).

sections.label: Vermin eating
sections.note: Gobble wiring writes which vermin classes each consumer eats (R51); foraging walks vermin eaters to real loose vermin on the map (R21); vermin hunting gives DF's hunting flag.

sections.label: Extinct corrections
sections.note: Apex odds, grazers, roles, group sizes and fossil realms of DF's extinct animals, corrected on load and restored on unload (R24).

sections.label: v7 switches
sections.note: Each v7.0 behaviour behind its own switch (`v7 KEY on|off|N`). Every change re-applies the v7 raws at once.

sections.label: Cavern irruptions
sections.note: Dwarves in and near a cavern raise its pressure; past the threshold a warning, then waves of the cavern's own civ races with behaviour tokens, and agitated cavern animals (R4-R6, R10). Opt-in.
